earnings.title: Tyler Technologies Reports Earnings for Third Quarter 2026
highlights: Recurring revenues were $568.8 million, up 11.0%, and comprised 87.8% of total revenues.
SaaS revenues grew 21.2% and free cash flow reached a new quarterly high

quotes.text: We achieved solid third quarter results, with double-digit recurring revenue growth, robust margin expansion, strong bookings, and record quarterly free cash flow.
quotes.by: Lynn Moore, Tyler's executive chair, president and chief executive officer

quotes.text: Third quarter results reflect the strength and resilience of Tyler's recurring revenue model. Recurring revenues grew 11.0%, driven by SaaS revenue growth of 21.2%.
quotes.by: Brian Miller, Tyler's executive vice president and chief financial officer
